note: Attacker-controlled JSON bytes are passed directly into the Variant JSON decoder.
The decoder extracts the nested TypeId from the JSON object to identify the body type.
A heap object is allocated for the decoded body, so later cleanup will own nested members.
The nested Body is decoded into the freshly allocated object using the type-specific decoder.

code: type-specific JSON decode of the Body value
note: For a crafted nested ExtensionObject/Variant payload, the body decoder can populate members that later require recursive cleanup.
When decoding fails or the Variant is destroyed, cleanup recursively frees the decoded body.
Structure cleanup walks each member and dispatches to the member clear routine, recursing into nested objects.
A NodeId with string/bytestring storage is cleared by freeing its internal buffer.

If the crafted JSON causes the same heap object to be referenced through nested decoded members, recursive cleanup can revisit already-freed storage, producing the reported use-after-free in the clear path.
